lastCompletedStory.title: Sweep orphaned implement-blocked marker at plan-phase dispatch

nextStoryContext: This PRD (CAM-288) contains only US-001, now passes:true. makeProductionPlanPhaseFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts) gained a 6th param sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarkerFn, invoked as the first statement inside its returned closure's try block (before runProductionPlanPhaseWithReplan/runPostPlanActions), reusing the existing SidecarOptions.sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarkerFn seam (CAM-282) so the same override fires at both the runSidecar startup site and every mid-session plan-phase dispatch. buildPlanPhaseDeps is now exported (mirrors buildMetaLoopFn's CAM-208 precedent) so a wiring test (test/commands/sidecar-plan-phase-orphan-sweep.test.ts) can drive it with a spy and assert the sweep fires per-dispatch, since the closure itself is not exported. src/commands/sidecar.ts's file-size ceiling was raised 2920->2941 in scripts/file-size-budget.json (staged with a dated _ref note) to accommodate the new param + doc comments.
